title: FAQ gets readable markdown and keeps its bullet points
summary:
A small garden day: clearer docs, sturdier API key metadata, and Azure model plumbing moved to Myceli.

The FAQ was moved toward a cleaner markdown-based format with more approachable language, and a rendering fix makes sure its bullet points actually appear. Documentation: briefly defeated by a list.

Azure-backed models now run through Myceli endpoints, and gptimage is enabled in the migration. More image-generation plumbing, exposed through the same simple interface.

Descriptions added to API keys now persist correctly in metadata, so keys can keep the context humans gave them.
